title: Teach the cell payload's role field wherever a cell is authored
action: Slice 3, the authoring-surface half of D7 and D8. The moment mrs-8 makes role required, every shipped cell payload example that omits it advertises a payload bee cells add now REFUSES — and this repo builds itself with bee, so an agent following planning-reference.md would author a refused cell. The plan moved this edit into slice 3 beside the field for exactly that reason. Add role to every cell payload example in the named files, and state D8's recommended vocabulary — code, read, test, docs, review, design — as GUIDANCE, explicitly noting that any name is legal and that an unconfigured name falls through with a warning rather than failing. Do NOT hand-edit the mirror trees under .claude/, .codex-plugin/, .opencode/ and .claude-plugin/: skills/ is the source and the mirrors are rendered, differing from it by intended runtime-conditional blocks. Run the regen chain inside this cell — bee dev regen — and let it write them. PROOF NOTE: the mirrors are NOT byte-identical to skills/, so the proof is that regen runs clean and bee dev release-manifest --check passes; never a byte-identity diff.
verify: PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml devtools && .bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check

truths: No shipped cell payload example omits the now-required role field
The recommended vocabulary is stated as guidance, with any-name-is-legal and the fall-through-warns behaviour said plainly
The mirror trees are written by regen, not by hand, and bee dev release-manifest --check passes
